title: Japanese Money Methods
note:
METHOD ONE — MOTTAINAI. The hinge lands on this chapter's first frame; the
     s33->s34 shove lives on the concat boundary.

     Ground arc: neutral warm on the word -> cool on "regret, not instruction"
     -> warm through the chain that made one shirt -> red on the hours -> GREEN
     HELD ACROSS THE THREE CHECKS, one third of the bar per check -> red on what
     they found -> cool -> green on the rule -> neutral for the arithmetic ->
     warm out.

     Archetypes: A A D A B B B A A D B A A. The bar under the three checks is the
     only element that carries ACROSS a cut, and it is what breaks the uniform
     +0.30/+1.10/+1.90 ladder once per chapter.

s34.comment:
4.1 · A · PLATE · no role · neutral warm — MOTTAINAI. A ceramic bowl on
     wood.

s35.comment: 4.2 · A · PLATE · no role · cool — NOT A SCOLDING. A hand sewing a patch.

s36.comment:
4.3 · D · BAND · no role · warm — ONE SHIRT. Three declared framings and
     three real photographs: the shirt, the cotton field, the truck. The chain IS
     the picture three times over.

s37.comment:
4.4 · A · PLATE · warn · red — AND YOURS. An "hours you worked for it" bar
     was drawn and cut: the script names no number, and a bar a viewer can read
     off is a statistic whether or not one was meant.

s38.comment:
4.5 · B · FIGURE · fund · green — CHECK ONE. Three checks are one
     instruction, so B is held and the bar moves a third per scene.

s39.comment:
4.6 · B · FIGURE · fund · green deeper — CHECK TWO; the bar picks up exactly
     where check one left it.

s40.comment: 4.7 · B · FIGURE · fund · green deepest — CHECK THREE; the bar closes.

s41.comment: 4.8 · A · PLATE · warn · red hot — WHAT YOU SAW. Unopened delivery boxes.

s42.comment:
4.9 · A · PLATE · no role · cool — IT IS ONE QUESTION. A hand picking up a
     product in a shop: the moment the question belongs to.

s43.comment:
4.10 · D · BAND · fund · green — THE QUESTION, and the chapter's one
     piece of drawn argument. One path in, two out, the MAYBE branch struck
     through. No photograph of an object on a table can state a decision rule.
